answer: nullifier epoch binds each agent to one anonymous credential per period, so one entity answers once. Each participant must post a stake and locks a fresh nullifier, and any duplicate burns the bonded deposit. A forger cannot reuse a key: a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes, and cost scales with depth, not key count. Honest clusters stay distinguishable because reuse slashes the shared bond, while a farm forces every fake to fund its own separate stake. Ivory tower proofs attest uniqueness, and this defence prices sybil signal out of existence.
